[SWS_UCM_00092] Package consistency
⌈
During TransferExit UCM
shall raise the ApplicationError PackageInconsistent if the package integrity
check fails. This package integrity check may be realized by the UCM via a Package
Checksum check or via other mechanisms.
⌋
